about.title: The house
about.intro: Most fragrance boxes tell you almost nothing. We print the full pyramid of notes on every bottle and the exact amount of every key ingredient on every jar, because you should be able to choose by what's inside.
about.make1: Each fragrance is mixed in batches of 400 bottles and left to rest for six weeks before it's filled.
about.make2: If an ingredient is on the front of a skincare jar, its percentage is next to it.
about.make3: Every 100 ml bottle unscrews, so it can be refilled instead of thrown away.
